title: Iki bundle (iki/v1)
description: A bundle's `bundle.json`: entities from one project of one deployment, with their history, for another deployment to import (ADR 0096). It lists the SHA-256 of every other member of the archive, and `bundle.json.sig` is the source deployment's Ed25519 signature of its bytes. The `$defs` are the lines of its NDJSON members.

apiVersion.description: The spec version this document follows.

deployment.description: Its name, such as `staging` (`IKI_ENVIRONMENT`). The importing deployment trusts keys by this name.

url.description: Its address, or empty if it has none configured.

key.description: The public key that signed it, as `ed25519:` and the key's 32 bytes in unpadded base64url.

project.description: The project its entities belong to.

id.description: The project's ID on the source deployment.

team.description: The name of the team it belongs to.

slug.description: Its slug, as its addresses use it.

selection.description: What was picked, in words, such as `COL-000004 (Validated primers) and what its members refer to`.

plugins.description: The plugins of the bundle's types, as installed when it was made.

counts.description: How many of each the bundle holds.

entries.description: The registry entries its records are of (ADR 0115).

outside.description: The entities it refers to that aren't in it: the lines of `outside.ndjson`.

members.description: Every other member of the archive, each once. A reader refuses an archive with a member that isn't here, or whose bytes don't match.

signing_keys.description: The keys that signed its electronic signatures (ADR 0126), and that vouch for what was done to their records' history since (`since`), each with the deployment its source trusts it as. As trusted as the bundle: its signature covers them.

key.description: A public key, as `ed25519:` and the key's 32 bytes in unpadded base64url.

deployment.description: The deployment the source trusts it as, such as `prod`.

time.description: An ISO 8601 date and time, with its offset.

path.description: `people.ndjson`, `agents.ndjson`, `files.ndjson`, `entries.ndjson`, `entities.ndjson`, `outside.ndjson`, `runs.ndjson`, or `blobs/sha256/` and a file's SHA-256 for its bytes.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of its bytes, in hex.

version.description: Its release, such as `1.2.0`, as installed.

sha.description: The git commit it was built from, or empty for a local build.

extensions.description: Its extensions of the bundle's types, by the type each extends, with each quantity field's unit.

units.description: Each quantity field's unit, by field name, which its values (in history too) are in.

types.description: Its types the bundle has entities of, with their parents, by qualified name.

schema_version.description: The type's schema version, which an import needs the type to have where it lands.

units.description: Each quantity field's unit, which its values (in history too) are in.

person.description: A line of `people.ndjson`: someone a record names. The importing deployment matches them by email.

id.description: The person's ID on the source deployment, which the bundle's other lines name them by.

kind.description: `person` for someone who signs in, `service` for a service account.

email.description: The person's email address, which matches them to a person where the bundle is imported.

name.description: Their name, which the placeholder an import makes for them takes if nobody matches.

agent.description: A line of `agents.ndjson`: an agent that acted for a person (ADR 0072), as the source stored it.

id.description: The agent's ID on the source deployment, which revisions, files and runs name it by.

key.description: A SHA-256 digest of the rest, in hex, which finds the agent again: an import uses the agent with the same key if there is one.

client_id.description: The ID of the OAuth client it acted through.

client_name.description: The client's name when the agent first acted.

grant.description: The person's grant the client acted under, or null for a service account's own credential.

session.description: The MCP session it acted in, or empty for MCP 2026-07-28 and later, which have none.

software.description: The software it says it is, from MCP's `clientInfo`. Iki can't check it.

model.description: The model it says it is, from the `Iki-Agent-Model` header. Iki can't check it.

file.description: A line of `files.ndjson`: a file a revision names. Iki's own files' bytes are the member `blobs/sha256/<sha256>`; a registered file's stay where they were registered.

id.description: The file's ID, which it keeps where it's imported.

name.description: The file's name, as it was added.

created_by.description: Who added it, from `people.ndjson`, or null.

agent.description: The agent that added it for them, from `agents.ndjson`, or null.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of its bytes, in hex.

registered.description: For a file registered where it was (ADR 0055), not copied into Iki: its address and object version.

uri.description: Where its bytes are, such as `s3://bucket/key`.

version.description: The object's version there, as its store names it, or empty if it has none.

acquired.description: When its data was acquired (ADR 0177), and how that's known: `given` by whoever added it, or the format that records it in the file, such as `abif`. Left out or null when unknown.

on.description: The day its data was acquired, for finding it by date.

at.description: The moment, as precisely as its source gave it: a date, or a date and time with or without an offset.

source.description: How that's known: `given`, or the format that records it, such as `abif`.

entity.description: A line of `entities.ndjson`: an entity, with every revision and the values each table of it held at each.

id.description: The entity's ID, which it keeps where it's imported.

hrid.description: Its HRID on the source deployment.

created_by.description: Who created it, from `people.ndjson`, or null.

archived_at.description: When it was archived, or null if it isn't.

entry.description: For a record of a registry entry (ADR 0115), the entry's ID: a line of `entries.ndjson`. Its HRID is the entry's.

history.description: Each table's values at each revision that changed it, as the source's history keeps them.

id.description: The revision's ID, which it keeps where it's imported.

number.description: 1 for the entity's creation, then 2, 3, and so on.

kind.description: What it did: created, edited, archived or restored the entity, moved it from a superseded registry entry to the one that replaced it, or set one of its state fields.

changed_fields.description: The fields whose values it set.

user.description: Who made it, from `people.ndjson`, or null.

via.description: How it was made: `web`, `api`, `mcp`, `cli` or `system`, or `run` for a run's results.

client.description: The OAuth app it came through, if any, as the audit log names it.

agent.description: The agent that made it for `user`, from `agents.ndjson`, or null.

reason.description: Why, if the person said; empty otherwise.

state.description: For a state change (ADR 0125): the state field set, and the states it went from and to.

signatures.description: For a revision that set a state with signatures (ADR 0126): those signatures, in order, from `signatures.ndjson`.

table.description: The type in the entity's chain whose table it is, such as `iki/dna.Sequence`, or for an extension, its plugin and the type it extends, such as `acme/lims:iki/dna.DNASequence`.

revision.description: The entity's revision at which the table had these values.

values.description: Every field the table has had, by name: refs and files by UUID, dates and times in ISO 8601, quantities in their field's unit, removed fields as null.

entry.description: A line of `entries.ndjson`: a registry entry the bundle's records are of (ADR 0115), with its identity, derived values and facts as they are now. Its history is its registry's, so it doesn't go: an import registers the identity in its project's registry, or finds it registered there.

id.description: The entry's ID on the source deployment, which its records' `entry` names.

type.description: The type it's registered as, such as `iki/small_molecule.Compound`.

hrid.description: Its registry ID on the source deployment, such as `CPD-000123`.

values.description: Its fields, by name, as `history` gives them.

outside.description: A line of `outside.ndjson`: an entity the bundle's values or runs refer to that isn't in it. Its HRID and type are given only if the exporter could read it.

hrid.description: Its HRID on the source deployment, or null.

type.description: Its type, such as `iki/dna.Plasmid`, or null.

why.description: `another-project`: owned by another project. `history`: only an earlier revision refers to it. `purged`: its plugin's data was purged. `run`: only a run's inputs or lineage refer to it. `unreadable`: the exporter can't read it.

run.description: A line of `runs.ndjson`: a finished run that made or changed the bundle's entities, with what it read, each attempt and its log, and what it made of what.

id.description: The run's ID, which it keeps where it's imported.

hrid.description: Its HRID on the source deployment, such as RUN-000123.

plugin_version.description: The release of its action's plugin it ran with.

plugin_sha.description: The plugin's commit, for reproducing it.

spec.description: The action as it was when it ran.

requested_by.description: Who asked for it, from `people.ndjson`, or null.

via.description: How it was asked for: `web`, `api`, `mcp`, `cli`, `trigger` or `system`.

client.description: The OAuth app it was asked for through, if any, as the audit log names it.

agent.description: The agent that asked for the person, from `agents.ndjson`, or null.

reason.description: Why, if the person said; empty otherwise.

tier.description: Where it ran: `self_hosted`, `backend`, `container` or `vm`, or `server` for Iki's own.

environment.description: The environment, as its action names it, that it ran in.

params.description: Every param's value, by name, with defaults filled in.

plugin_settings.description: The plugin's settings at launch (never secrets).

seed.description: The seed for its command's random numbers, given as `IKI_SEED`, or null for a run from before seeds.

status.description: How it ended: only finished runs go.

started_at.description: When it started, or null if it never did.

error.description: Why it failed, if it did.

timeout.description: The seconds each attempt may run.

max_attempts.description: The attempts it may take: its first, and its retries.

retry_on.description: The failures it's retried after, such as `worker_lost` and `interrupted`.

reproduction.description: How it compared with the run it reproduced, if it reproduced one.

linked.description: Runs and their groups it's tied to on the source deployment, which don't go with it.

batch.description: The batch it was launched in, or null.

id.description: The batch's ID on the source deployment.

workflow.description: The workflow run it's a step of, or null.

id.description: The workflow run's ID on the source deployment.

step.description: The step's ID in the workflow.

reused_from.description: The identical run whose results it reused instead of running, or null.

id.description: That run's ID on the source deployment.

reproduces.description: The run it reproduced, comparing its results with that run's, or null.

id.description: That run's ID on the source deployment.

approval.description: Who decided on it, when an agent asked for it; null when none did.

anyOf.description: Who approved it, when an agent asked for it (ADR 0072).

state.description: `pending`, `approved`, `declined`, or `expired` when nobody decided in time.

requested_by.description: The person the agent asked for, who alone could decide, from `people.ndjson`.

agent.description: The agent that asked, from `agents.ndjson`, or null.

client.description: The OAuth app that asked, as the audit log names it.

decided_by.description: Who decided, from `people.ndjson`, or null if nobody did.

note.description: Why it was declined, if the person said.

inputs.description: Each entity it was given, at the revision it read.

name.description: The action's input it was given for.

position.description: Its place among that input's entities, from 0.

entity.description: The entity's ID: a line of `entities.ndjson`, or of `outside.ndjson` if it didn't go.

consent.description: Who agreed to send its data to outside APIs, and to what (ADR 0130): only on runs that called any.

via.description: How: in the web app, through the API, or by approving an agent's request.

client.description: The OAuth app they agreed through, if any, as the audit log names it.

agent.description: The agent whose request they approved, from `agents.ndjson`, or null.

statements.description: Each API, with what's sent and the statement shown: `api`, `label`, `host`, `purpose`, `inputs`, `params` and `statement`.

api_calls.description: Each call to an outside API, and each poll and cancel of a job it waited on, as the egress proxy recorded them (ADR 0130): only on runs that called any.

job.description: The ID of the attempt it was made for.

kind.description: `call`: a request the run's command made. `poll`: asking after a parked run's job. `cancel`: asking the API to cancel it.

path.description: The path, without the query, which may hold data.

status.description: The HTTP status the API answered, or null if it didn't answer.

error.description: Why the call failed, or empty.

duration_ms.description: How long it took, in milliseconds.

request_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the request body, in hex, or empty.

response_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the response body as the API sent it, in hex, or empty.

model.description: The model the answer said answered, where the plugin says to find it, or empty.

version.description: The model's version the answer gave, where the plugin says to find it, or empty.

parameters.description: The request's parameters the plugin declares, by JSON pointer, as sent.

usage.description: The usage the answer reported, by the names the plugin declares, such as `gpu_seconds`.

made_with.description: The software Iki recorded it made each of the bundle's entities with (ADR 0106): its action's, or those its output named. Older bundles leave it out.

entity.description: The entity it made: a line of `entities.ndjson`.

version.description: Its version, or empty if it isn't known.

included.description: What its inputs' references named, that it read too (ADR 0105): only on runs that read any.

input.description: The input whose entity's reference named it.

position.description: That entity's place among the input's, from 0.

field.description: The reference field that named it.

index.description: Its place in that field: 0 for a single reference, its index in a list.

entity.description: The entity it read: a line of `entities.ndjson` or `outside.ndjson`.

effects.description: What it did to the bundle's entities.

kind.description: `created`, `updated`, or `reused` when it made an entity that existed already.

revision.description: The revision it made, or null when it reused the entity or changed nothing.

lineage.description: Which of the bundle's entities it made from which of its inputs, at which revisions.

entity.description: The entity it made: a line of `entities.ndjson`.

parent.description: The entity it made it from: a line of `entities.ndjson` or `outside.ndjson`.

input.description: The run's input the parent was given as.

origins.description: The public records it read the bundle's entities from.

entity.description: The entity it made from the record: a line of `entities.ndjson`.

revision.description: The revision it made, or null when it found the entity already there.

identifier.description: The record's accession, or its name.

version.description: The record's version at the source, or empty.

retrieved_at.description: When it was retrieved, or null if that isn't known.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the record as read, in hex, or empty.

file.description: The file it was read from, one of the run's file params, from `files.ndjson`; null if it wasn't read from one.

made.description: How the record says its source made the entity (ADR 0106).

id.description: The attempt's ID, which `api_calls` name it by.

attempt.description: 1 for the first attempt, then 2, 3, and so on.

state.description: How it ended. `interrupted`: its worker went away or was stopped. `parked`: it submitted an outside API's job, and a new attempt resumed once that was done.

environment_build.description: The digest of the environment build its worker ran it with, or empty when the worker used its host's own software.

resources.description: What it needed: its environment's minimum resources, raised by its action's own.

started_at.description: When it started, or null if it never did.

error.description: Why it ended badly, as `code` and `message`, or null.

owner.description: Always null: workers once ran on people's own computers, which self-hosted workers replaced (ADR 0112).

volumes.description: The versions of its environment's volumes it had (ADR 0075).

output.description: What its command reported (`run-output/v1`), as its worker sent it, or null if it ended without reporting. An attempt that parked on an outside API's job (ADR 0130) has its own, and the attempt that resumed it the results: the run's output is its last attempt's.

signature.description: A line of `signatures.ndjson`: an electronic signature under 21 CFR Part 11 (ADR 0126). `document` is what was signed, canonical JSON (RFC 8785); `signature` its Ed25519 signature, base64url; `content` the record's content at the revision signed, whose SHA-256 the document names. `iki bundle verify` checks each against the bundle's history.

id.description: The signature's ID, which it keeps where it's imported.

record.description: The record it signs: a line of `entities.ndjson`.

revision.description: The record's revision it signs: what the signer read.

entry_revision.description: For a record of a registry entry, the entry's revision then; null otherwise.

field.description: The state field it signs for setting.

state.description: The state it signs for setting that field to.

index.description: Which of the signatures setting that state needs it is, from 0.

meaning.description: What the signer signed as (21 CFR 11.50(a)(3)).

deployment.description: The name of the deployment it was signed on.

key.description: The public key that signed it, as `ed25519:` and the key's 32 bytes in unpadded base64url.

document.description: What was signed: canonical JSON (RFC 8785) that names the SHA-256 of `content`.

signature.description: The Ed25519 signature of `document`'s bytes, in unpadded base64url.

content.description: The record's content at the revision signed, as canonical JSON.

since.description: What was done to its record's history after it was signed, in order, vouched for by the exporting deployment's signing key (ADR 0148): its `document`, `iki/read-through/v1` canonical JSON naming the signature, its record and revision, and the changes (a field renamed, a quantity converted to another unit as `new = old * scale + offset`, the type renamed, and an import naming people and registry entries by their IDs where it was imported, ADR 0096), the `key` that signed it, and its Ed25519 `signature`. `iki bundle verify` and an import check it with the keys they trust, then do each change to `content` before checking it against the bundle's history. Null if nothing was done.

document.description: `iki/read-through/v1` canonical JSON naming the signature, its record and revision, and the changes, in order.

key.description: The exporting deployment's signing key that vouches for it, as `ed25519:` and the key's 32 bytes in unpadded base64url.

signature.description: That key's Ed25519 signature of `document`'s bytes, in unpadded base64url.

withdrawn.description: Its signer took it back before the state it signed for was set.
